title: Time Efficient Exercise to Reverse Sarcopenia and Improve Cardio-metabolic Health
official: Time Efficient Exercise to Reverse Sarcopenia and Improve Cardio-metabolic Health
summary: Participants will be 60-80 y men and women who vary their physical activity (steps/day) while their lipid metabolism is studied (n=24). Thereafter, another group (n=60) will perform 6 months of exercise training focused on developing maximal cycling power, during which their changes in muscle mass and practical function will be carefully measured.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* relatively healthy

Exclusion Criteria:

* relatively unhealthy
